verdict.rationale: Hatchet offers debounce-like collapsing through the `CANCEL_QUEUED_EXCEPT_NEWEST`/`OLDEST` concurrency strategies with configurable queue depth per key. Scheduled Runs cover delayed triggers, and CEL event filters, per-key concurrency and rate limits help suppress noisy events. However, none of this is documented as a first-class debounce or batch trigger, and the delay and rate-limit evidence is only page titles. Missing for 10: explicit debounce/batch trigger primitives, any evidence of event batching (collapsing many events into one run), detailed docs on delayed triggers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
